title: Asymptotics and Inverse Growth for Weighted Distinct Partitions
mathematical_scope: Relative coefficient equivalent using an exact integral saddle
Poincare logarithmic expansion at every fixed inverse-logarithmic order
Lambert-W inverse-growth expansion with remainder and a finer resummed inverse bound
limitations: No convergent full transseries or error uniform in growing truncation order
No exact inverse threshold rounding rule

sources.title: OEIS A022629
sources.use: Definition and logarithmic conjecture attributed to V. Kotesovec, 2018

sources.title: Naranjo and Ramírez, On Colored Partitions and Euler-Type Identities
sources.use: Exact colored-partition interpretation, with no asymptotic formula in that discussion

sources.title: Granovsky and Stark, Developments in the Khintchine-Meinardus probabilistic method for asymptotic enumeration
sources.use: Classical probabilistic method; inside-weight assumption excludes a direct application to growing weight k

verification.acceptance_arithmetic: Exact symbolic polynomials and rational arithmetic
verification.numerical_examples: Orientation only; not interval-certified or used in the proof
